description: Call this before any creative or open-ended request (an image, a picture prompt, a story, a poem, a name, an idea, a design, a plan), so the result is varied instead of your usual answer and still exactly what was asked. First call: send the user's request word for word in `request` (and `randomness` only if the user asked for more or less variety). It returns an exploring step and an `id`. Do that step silently, without showing it to the user, and call this tool again with the `id` and your whole reply to the step in `explored`. The second call returns what was decided. Then make the result itself in the same reply: for a request for an image, generate the image with your image generation tool and show it (a written prompt is not the result); for writing, write it. The result shows every decided answer.

explored.description: Second call: your whole reply to the exploring step, its answer lines with their shares and the final ```json block included.

id.description: Second call: the id the first call returned.

keep.description: First call, optional: Only when the user wants to keep part of an earlier Model Salt result and vary the rest ("keep the palette and layout", "same colours, new drawings", or a pasted `Kept:` line): the decided answers they want kept, copied from that earlier Model Salt reply, one item each as "<what> = <answer>", e.g. "palette = burnt orange on cream". If the last Model Salt reply began with a `Kept:` line, send its items again on every later call for this work, until the user says to start fresh. Leave it out when the user wants something new, another one, or a fresh start.

randomness.description: First call, optional: how varied the result should be: 0 the usual answer, 1 clearly varied (the default), 2 as varied as it gets. Leave it out unless the user asks for more or less variety.

request.description: First call: the user's request, word for word.
